title: 所有字段齐全且地址存在时返回success=true
preconditions: 服务正常运行；lsp_dev.lsp_address_suburb_postcode 中存在 postcode=2500/state=NSW/suburb=NORTH WOLLONGONG/country=AU
validation_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lsp_dev.lsp_address_suburb_postcode WHERE country_code='AU' AND state_code='NSW' AND postcode='2500' AND suburb_name='north wollongong';

title: country 传全称 Australia 时成功识别并验证地址
preconditions: 服务正常运行；lsp_dev.lsp_address_suburb_postcode 中存在对应记录
expected_result: HTTP 200；data.success=true；data.country 或 data.countryCode 返回正确；说明全称 Australia 被兼容
validation_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lsp_dev.lsp_address_suburb_postcode WHERE country_code='AU' AND state_code='NSW' AND postcode='2500' AND suburb_name='north wollongong';

title: state 传全称 New South Wales 时成功识别并验证地址
expected_result: HTTP 200；data.success=true；说明州全称 New South Wales 被兼容转换为 NSW
validation_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lsp_dev.lsp_address_suburb_postcode WHERE country_code='AU' AND state_code='NSW' AND postcode='2500' AND suburb_name='north wollongong';

title: suburb 传全大写时大小写兼容验证成功
validation_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lsp_dev.lsp_address_suburb_postcode WHERE country_code='AU' AND state_code='NSW' AND postcode='2500' AND UPPER(suburb_name)='NORTH WOLLONGONG';

title: suburb 传混合大小写时大小写兼容验证成功
validation_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lsp_dev.lsp_address_suburb_postcode WHERE country_code='AU' AND state_code='NSW' AND postcode='2500' AND LOWER(suburb_name)=LOWER('North Wollongong');

test_item: 不传 country 默认为 Australia
title: 不传 country 字段时默认使用 Australia 进行验证
steps:
1. POST /address/validate
2. Body: {"state":"NSW","postcode":"2500","suburb":"north wollongong","address":"10 Park Ave"}（不传 country）
3. 查看响应
expected_result: HTTP 200；data.success=true；系统默认使用 Australia(AU) 进行验证
validation_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lsp_dev.lsp_address_suburb_postcode WHERE country_code='AU' AND state_code='NSW' AND postcode='2500' AND suburb_name='north wollongong';

title: country 传小写 au 时系统兼容识别
expected_result: HTTP 200；data.success=true（country 小写兼容）或 data.success=false（记录行为差异）
